limits: Small pilot: one independent source family per split; not population-wide generalization
Authored after algorithm lock by the same researcher, not an external blinded benchmark
Explicit anchor-only evaluation cannot establish seed detection or wrapper context invariance
Targets statically analyzed, not executed; labels justified by source algebra/counterexamples
Peak working set measures direct child only, not total process-tree memory
No assertion that v0.2 improves until measured; no old held-out tuning
Previous dataset outcomes are known; repeated measurements do not increase independent source-family sample size.
